verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents a first-party MCP server and Agent Skills that let AI agents use natural language to query metrics, traces, logs and alerts, and to manage dashboards, alert rules, saved views and notification channels. Its documented use cases include natural-language dashboard creation. Missing for 10: no in-app natural-language interface (it relies on an external AI client such as Claude or Cursor), and no independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language workflows work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Use natural language to query metrics, traces, and logs; investigate alerts; and manage dashboards, alert rules, saved views, and notification channels.
Connect Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and other AI agents to SigNoz via MCP for natural language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.
Install the SigNoz plugin and Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Gemini can query data, build dashboards, manage alerts, and explore SigNoz docs.
